title: Thinking on Success & Models for Building Success
summary: Kahran and Divya try to construct an explicit model of success — not as a single direct attempt, but as a set of blocks you can identify, assemble and check progress against. They use designing software sounds for Windows 7 as an example of building a language of patterns, novelists spending the first third in plot construction, and the tech industry's bad habit of disrespecting pre-production work.

intents.display: to build a personal model for what your success is made of
